name: ClinPGx / PharmGKB
scope: Annotations linking variants, genes and drugs: variant annotations (4.1 MB zip), relationships (4.1 MB), summary annotations (1.2 MB), clinical guideline annotations, drug labels, pathways.
mapping_methods: rsID- and haplotype-level; coordinates must be mapped separately.

quantitative.summary: Evidence levels and categorical annotations; some effect sizes in variant annotations.

licence.name: CC BY-SA 4.0 (data usage policy)
licence.redistribution: Share-alike and attribution required for redistribution

known_omissions: Structural/copy-number haplotypes (e.g. CYP2D6 duplications) need PharmVar/CPIC definitions

reuse_decision.rationale: Small archives; Open Targets only carries a pharmacogenomics subset.
